description: This source file defines the 'Order' class within the admin entity package of a sales management application. It contains fields representing order details, such as ID, purchase date, order status list, related order object, delivery, billing, and order history comments. It provides getter and setter methods for these fields, encapsulating order-related data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order entity in the sales management system, with properties for order details, status, delivery, and billing, along with relevant getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date of the order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Returns the comment related to the order history.

methods.name: setOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Sets the comment related to the order history.

methods.name: getOrderStatusList
methods.description: Returns the list of possible order statuses.

methods.name: setOrderStatusList
methods.description: Sets the list of possible order statuses.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the associated core order object.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates a core order object with this order.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the delivery details related to the order.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery details for the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns the billing information for the order.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing information for the order.
